get_config_for_training: get a jaxline config object for training a transformer on omniglot data with bursty sequences
get_config_in_debug_mode: get a reduced transformer config with 2 layers and 2 heads by calling get_config with debug set to true
configure_omniglot_exemplars: configure the omniglot dataset to use all exemplars across all 1623 classes via the omniglot config dict
configure_transformer_architecture: configure the transformer model architecture with 12 layers and 8 attention heads using the transformer config dict
configure_evaluation_modes: configure evaluation modes for fewshot and holdout tasks based on the zipf exponent setting
